about: Conditions: states applied to a creature for a while (or until removed). modifiers use the Orsino vocabulary (see src/rules/modifiers.ts); onTurnEnd damage or healing happens at the end of the holder's turn, or on each tick of a world-time clock. Orsino statuses are generated into data/catalog/orsino/conditions.json; this file holds Kyr's own conditions and deliberate adaptations of Orsino ones.

poisoned.name: Poisoned
poisoned.description: Poison works through the body, hurting a little at a time until it is cured.

source.notes: A world condition that lasts beyond an encounter and is cured by an antidote; Orsino's poison ends with the fight.

bleeding.name: Bleeding
bleeding.description: A wound that keeps bleeding until it is bound.

source.notes: A world condition treated by rest or a poultice; Orsino's bleed ends with the fight.
Exact 50% fire resistance. It persists beyond an encounter for as long as the applying salve or ward says, and one source refreshes rather than stacks.

wayfarer_guard.name: Wayfarer's guard
wayfarer_guard.description: Veyra watches over the traveller: saves come easier.

lit.name: Lit
lit.description: A conjured light hangs over its bearer's shoulder for a while.

source.notes: Kyr's light: while it lasts, the company can see in unlit places.

lit.begins: A small steady light kindles over {target}'s shoulder.

torchlit.name: Torchlit
torchlit.description: Carrying a burning torch: light against the dark, and fire to hand.

source.notes: A torch burns about an hour: light in unlit places, and a flame for what needs burning.

unbarring.name: Unbarring
unbarring.description: Locks open at a touch for a while.
unbarring.begins: Locks will open at {target}'s touch for the next hour.
unbarring.ends: The unbarring on {target}'s hands is spent.

source.notes: The effect of Knock: for an hour its bearer opens what lockwork opens.

guarded.name: Guarded
guarded.description: Someone stands in front of them and takes the blows meant for them.
guarded.begins: Until their guard acts again, blows aimed at {target} meet the guard instead.

source.notes: Interception without positions: a blow aimed at the holder strikes whoever is guarding them.

fleeing.name: Fleeing
fleeing.description: Turned to flight: it will be gone from the fight when the next round begins.

source.notes: Orsino's flee effect (Ability.handleSingleEffect) gives its target this status, {flee: true}, for two turns; Combat removes a fleeing enemy when the next round begins.

unlit_law.name: The Unlit's law
unlit_law.description: In the Unlit fire burns small and cold, wounds close slowly, and fear comes easily.

source.notes: A place law, as Orsino's planes carry global effects every resident holds (planeModifiers.globalEffects): fire resisted by half, healing two less, will saves two worse.

beacon_law.name: Under the beacon
beacon_law.description: Lampfall's beacon burns: in its light the dead are slow and the living steady.

source.notes: The law of the Unlit where Lampfall's beacon has been relit.
